discovery_notes: Follow-up 4 of B014 (packets 214, 421, 463, 495; Disney Store 2018). 30 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked, snippets only. New: Film Strip 8 per-film pins (LGPT checklist, LE 300 each); Pinsgiving set #1 completed via MPC per-pin pages (Mowgli & Baloo, Genie/Carpet, Cogsworth & Lumiere hold released, Up = Carl & Russell); Surprise Simba Cursive Cuties 4 May 2018 and set name for 4 May series; 28 Sep 2018 Cursive Cuties set; Memories set 11 date 17 Nov 2018; Dec Park Pack format (3 variants each). Holds kept: Marvel 10th, Aug Park Pack names, Dec Mulan naming, RBI, Memories Jan, Incredibles EU, MP&Friends, PTD Aug sizes. Resellers not used.
